visible_pilots.why_case_exists: The clearest answer-first fixture in the pilot, with an adjacent-year shift vivid enough to make the default reading order legible immediately.
The bounded contrast fixture: pricing, reimbursement, policy, and concentration pressure show that the protocol is not just a semiconductor story while keeping the public LLY boundary explicit.
The honesty-check fixture: mostly stable language tests whether the workflow stays useful without forcing drama or pretending every filing needs a vivid shift.

product_statement: Document Protocol Lab currently ships one bounded visible SEC Item 1A pilot instead of a broad company catalog.
anti_hype_statement: Document Protocol Lab currently ships this deliberately compact three-fixture pilot, not a broad issuer catalog or research platform.
why_this_mix_matters: NVDA gives the strongest first signal, LLY tests the protocol in a policy-heavy bounded contrast, and KO checks whether the same workflow stays honest on a mostly stable filing.
